REFUTED as a registered claim: 'a company shape exists' (>= 0.65 in >= 15 languages): only 7 of 22 reach 0.65 at LATER (mean 0.615 is above the permutation q95 and C5 holds, so a modest shape does exist); register-robustness P5 failed; family-specific P4 held as 'not specific'.

UPPER BOUNDS, not name-detector strengths: IRC S_ENTRY 0.843 (6 channel-days), local mention count 0.853, physics within-count nickname AUC 0.81 (0.806 wave 2). 92.1% of nickname mentions are message-initial vs 9.3% of tokens, a message-initial indicator alone scores 0.918, the reader's 3-character figure floor makes every 1-2 character negative invisible by construction (all earlier IRC results), and matched-on-frequency negatives do not match local clustering. After matching position, length, character length: S_ENTRY 0.653 / 0.717, local count 0.60-0.62 (IRC-SENTRY-MATCHED).

NOT SHOWN: a single mention is audible to the ABLATION reader causally. A fitted classifier hears them in War and Peace (0.627 vs q 0.542) but its labels come from capitals (control only).

REFUTED: inertia. DEAD physics words (physics-handles REPORT.md): momentum (persistence ratio 1.000, reliability 0.07); density (n, n/L, Born share all within 0.5% deviance of a constant; Born edge 0.4-0.8% below the 2% bar); time dilation (every key decays at one rate, the measured dmdWindow is the ceiling in 24 of 24 cells, Spearman(H_slot, H_cast) 0.50 < 0.6); Schwarzschild horizon (partial given mass -0.07 [-0.22, 0.09], horizon falls with n, rho -0.25, 80% of bodies have no conclusion to change); conservation (a deletion empties 1.18 slots, creates 0.02; wave 2 0.97 / 0.03); the warp as a property of beings (excess over matched random deletion positive for 43-51% of bodies, 0 of 11 corpora pass; slope vs mass 0.99 deletion vs 0.90 random); warp = gravity (partial rho -0.06, raw -0.10, needed 0.30); geodesic bending (3 of 11 corpora).

NOT ESTABLISHED: equivalence of inertial and gravitational mass: partial rho 0.114 [0.029, 0.204] with attraction energy (deranged q95 0.064, positive in 6 of 8 corpora; needed 0.30); the pre-registered 'fails within +-0.10' narrowly failed, so the relation is weakly positive at best; the curvature version was not tested.

NOT ESTABLISHED: a power-law attraction with a stable or family-specific exponent (rho -0.11 between folds on 13 powered languages, median |diff| 0.22; 0.13 on 21; permutation p 0.039 fold A, 0.73 fold B); burst memory is exponential (power wins 2 of 21), not power.

DEFECT (verified, not edited): kernel/activation.js observe() stamps t: now + 1 and decays to now, so a key observed on consecutive ticks never decays: observed every tick for 400 ticks with window 8, activationOf = 400 while the decayed total stays near 8; per-key activations do not sum to total. Fixing it changes measured results (the user's call).

REFUTED: salience ranks names. Final-config salience AUC for names 0.447 (DEV), 0.416 (fold A, below 0.5 in 18 of 23 stems), 0.448 (fold B, 18 of 25); at stage s0 it was 0.52. A name the language says often is not less of a being; only the 'is it key' membership question for descriptors was worth keeping.

REFUTED: the refusal floor is a 5% loss bound: held-out lost naming <= 5% in 15 of 25 stems (fold A), 12 (fold B), 13 (DEV); the naive 'refuse below 5% naming mass' catches 3.5% of non-names vs 36% for plurality (vacuous); R is F1-neutral (+0.001 / -0.001).

REFUTED: recurrence is name evidence among multi-arrival candidates: the 'recur' rule ranks recurring names at AUC 0.465 (24 stems, fold A) and is the best single rule in 0 of 25 stems; existence is not 'occurs twice' (the memory-note rule stands: recurrence is standing, never existence).

REFUTED: the graded (Born-weighted evidence) cast replaces the shipped on/off tier on recurring gold: G minus shipped -0.177 / -0.160 (0 of 23 / 24 stems up; VG1 failed); DMD weighting no better than equal weights (G minus Gq -0.079 / -0.070; G beats the rotated-weights control in only 6 / 5 stems; VG2 failed). It wins only on all-PROPN gold (+0.090 / +0.105), i.e. through one-arrival names.

REFUTED on TEST (before the S fix): the original 5% standing gate adds anything over the prior's own lexicon filter: R3 passes 0 of 23 measurable languages, K:lexicon_filter and K:shuffled fail 23 of 23; the capital-letter witness (non-causal) beats the lowercase heard reader in 13 of 16 cased languages (competence/CARD.md section 7). The shipped S, R, A changes are fold-tested, not TEST-tested.

NO REGISTER-ROBUST SIGN: in UD a PROPN leaves a SMALLER shadow than matched common words (extent AUC 0.453 by tokens, 0.439 by frames, below 0.45 in 14 of 22 languages), in IRC a larger one (0.77); a UD-trained MAGNITUDE arm scores 0.21 on IRC; code-trained arms score 0.33-0.41 on IRC nicknames; sameLeft is 0.37-0.41 for code identifiers and 0.859 for IRC nicknames. Polarity must be learned or fixed per register.
